Statement of Financial Information (“SOFI”)

View SOFI Reports

In accordance with Section 2 of the Financial Information Act, public bodies must prepare the Statement of Financial Information (SOFI) within six months of the corporation’s year end. SOFI reports are presented for approval by Council each year before they are submitted to the Ministry of Community, Sport and Cultural Development. This report consists of the audited financial statements, a schedule showing the remuneration and expenses paid to (or on behalf of) employees, a schedule of the District’s payments to suppliers, and a statement of severance agreements.

Annual Municipal Report

View Annual Reports

In accordance with the Community Charter, an annual report must be prepared and made available to the public before June 30 each year.

Background:

The Financial Information Act requires municipalities to present a Statement of Financial Information (SOFI), as additional financial information to the Financial Statements. The SOFI statements must be approved by Council and the Financial Officer and made available for public inspection within six months of year end.

Once these are approved by Council, the Statement of Financial Information will be available at the municipal office for inspection during normal business hours and will also be posted under on the District website.
